steps.title: Select and culture MC3T3-E1 cells
steps.instruction: Use the mineralizing subclone 4 of MC3T3‑E1 (ATCC #CRL‑2593). Culture passages 8–21 in a T25 flask with 5 mL growth media at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Replace medium every 2 days and subculture at a 1:4 ratio with 0.25 % trypsin when cells reach 80–90 % confluence.

steps.title: Induce osteogenic differentiation
steps.instruction: Seed 2.5–3 × 10⁶ cells in 30 mL growth media in a T150 flask. Change media every 2 days until the culture reaches 80–90 % confluence, then switch to osteogenic media and culture for an additional 21 days, changing media every 3 days.

steps.title: Collect conditioned osteogenic media
steps.instruction: After 21 days, collect the osteogenic media, keep it on ice, and if not processed immediately store at –80 °C (several weeks) without loss of MV quality.

steps.title: Remove debris and large vesicles
steps.instruction: All following steps are performed at 4 °C on ice. Centrifuge the collected media at 2,000 × g for 20 min to pellet cell debris. Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 50 mL tube and centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 30 min to remove large vesicles/apoptotic bodies (alternatively filter through a 0.45 µm syringe filter).

steps.title: Ultracentrifugation to pellet matrix vesicles
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant into pre‑chilled ultracentrifuge polypropylene tubes and centrifuge at 100,000 × g for 1 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and store matrix vesicle pellet
steps.instruction: Gently decant the supernatant and resuspend the MV pellet in 50 µL ice‑cold 1× DPBS by pipetting up and down (if the pellet is hard to see, leave up to 10 µL supernatant). Adjust the suspension to a final volume of 20 µL DPBS. The MV suspension can be used immediately or stored in a 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 0.6 N HCl solution
steps.instruction: Measure 4.97 mL of 37 % HCl into a 100 mL beaker, add distilled water to a final volume of 100 mL, and mix thoroughly with a magnetic stir bar.

steps.title: Quantify MV protein by BCA assay
steps.instruction: Generate a BSA standard curve (see Table 1) in 1.7 mL tubes. Add 80 µL 1× RIPA buffer and 2 µL protease inhibitor to 20 µL MV suspension in DPBS, mix, incubate 1 h, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 20 min and collect the supernatant. Pipette 10 µL of each BSA standard and MV sample (in triplicate) into a 96‑well plate, add 200 µL BCA working solution, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, read absorbance at 562 nm, and calculate protein concentration using the standard curve (Table 2).

substeps.instruction: Prepare BSA standards: 2.00 mg/mL (200 µL BSA stock + 100 µL H₂O), 1.00 mg/mL (100 µL BSA + 100 µL H₂O), 0.50 mg/mL (50 µL BSA + 150 µL H₂O), 0.25 mg/mL (25 µL BSA + 175 µL H₂O), 0.125 mg/mL (12.5 µL BSA + 187.5 µL H₂O), 0.0625 mg/mL (6.25 µL BSA + 193.75 µL H₂O).
Lyse MV sample: 20 µL MV + 80 µL 1× RIPA + 2 µL protease inhibitor; incubate 1 h; centrifuge 14,000 × g 20 min; collect supernatant.
Plate 10 µL of each standard and sample in triplicate.
Add 200 µL BCA working solution to each well.
Calculate concentration using the standard curve (e.g., MV sample average OD = 0.219 → 375 µg/mL).

steps.title: Measure MV size by NTA
steps.instruction: Dilute the isolated MV sample in 1 mL DPBS, vortex 15 s, then slowly inject the dilution into the NTA chamber with a needleless syringe, avoiding bubbles. Adjust concentration so that 30–50 particles are visible in the field of view before acquiring size and concentration data.

steps.title: Optional SEM‑EDS analysis of MV composition
steps.instruction: Deposit 10 µL of MV suspension on lacey carbon‑coated 300 mesh copper grids, air‑dry 30 min at room temperature, and image with a 200 kV HF5000 TEM equipped with an EDS detector in STEM mode. Acquire SEM images and EDS maps, then calculate elemental atomic % for Ca and P.

steps.title: Cell‑free calcification assay of MV activity
steps.instruction: Place a 22 mm collagen‑coated glass coverslip in each well of a 12‑well plate. Add 25 µg MV (based on the BCA protein result) in 200 µL osteogenic media, spread evenly, and incubate at 37 °C for 72 h in a CO₂ incubator. Decant the media, wash once with 1× DPBS, then add 250 µL 0.6 N HCl to each well, covering the coverslip, and incubate at room temperature for 24 h to decalcify. Collect the 250 µL HCl supernatant and measure calcium concentration using a colorimetric Ca²⁺ assay kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µg MV + 200 µL osteogenic media; incubate 37 °C 72 h.
Decant media gently; wash once with 1× DPBS.
Add 250 µL 0.6 N HCl; incubate RT 24 h.
Determine calcium content with colorimetric assay.
